input.admin_user: <admin_user: The administrator the setup signs in as (it runs useradd and reloads sshd)>

input.remotePort: <remotePort: The server's loopback port the tunnel listens on>
input.localPort: <localPort: The door's port on this computer the tunnel reaches>
